records.replacement: `/goods/counts/*` is the count target; `/stock-count/*` schedule, adjustments and write-offs, `/stock/vflips/*` become one controlled correction/count journey
records.migration_requirements: Map snapshots, blind passes, recounts, variances, reasons, approval bands and corrections to one journal. Later full SOH snapshots belong to C08/SO-08 retained correction/count, never another opening. The narrow sole-online-alpha trading snapshot adapter is implemented in outbound.goods_soh_reconciliation with exact persisted pause/frontier, SITE-before-DOCUMENT lock order and actual concurrency denial proof. Initial-parent repeat protection is implemented in ptmapper.soh_services. Generic non-trading counts retain their existing gate. Only zero/reduction closure is supported; gains, encumbrances, nonordinary custody, offline frontiers and real-tenant acceptance remain inactive or pending. SohImport independently reviewed source and cutoff -> outbound.goods_soh_views Start/Detail/Mutation -> goods_soh_reconciliation begin/submit/cancel/_decide -> SiteGuard SITE lock before RegisteredTill DOCUMENT lock -> snapshot_pause_evidence persisted TillPause, allocation/frontier/reservation/UUID reconciliation -> frozen canonical GoodsStocktake book -> independent versioned count.review -> zero-close or P13 reduction at original origin cost -> retained journal and goods stock readers; access revalidation before commit and DTO delivery. Fresh source inputs, stable identity/governance, working set, book/journal watermark, count reasons and approval versions are rechecked. Full offline till reconciliation and gains/encumbered/nonordinary differences remain unsupported/inactive.
records.acceptance_evidence: Reconcile before/after balances and preserve approval evidence. Later full SOH snapshots belong to C08/SO-08, using the retained goods count/correction journey; they must not replay opening balances or historical source movements. Pending dependencies: ptmapper.soh_services.requires_inventory_reconciliation and apply_batch initial-parent fence; outbound.goods_counts.start_count/current_declaration SiteGuard freeze and journal snapshot; C10/SO-09 registered-till pause, unresolved UUID outcomes and numbered-bill reconciliation; C06 retained stock journal/readers. Trading-store counts remain inactive until the separately approved R-INV-009/ST-INV-3/OQ-57 pause, source cutoff and independent delta review contracts have current evidence.
records.removal_condition: Retire duplicate count/correction writes when freeze, replay and authority tests pass.

Fresh source inputs, stable identity/governance, working set, book/journal watermark, count reasons and approval versions are rechecked. Full offline till reconciliation and gains/encumbered/nonordinary differences remain unsupported/inactive.

Trading-store counts remain inactive until the separately approved R-INV-009/ST-INV-3/OQ-57 pause, source cutoff and independent delta review contracts have current evidence.

records.migration_requirements: Map snapshots, blind passes, recounts, variances, reasons, approval bands and corrections to one journal. Later full SOH snapshots belong to C08/SO-08 retained correction/count, never another opening. The narrow sole-online-alpha trading snapshot adapter is implemented in outbound.goods_soh_reconciliation with exact persisted pause/frontier, SITE-before-DOCUMENT lock order and actual concurrency denial proof. Initial-parent repeat protection is implemented in ptmapper.soh_services. Generic non-trading counts retain their existing gate. Only zero/reduction closure is supported; gains, encumbrances, nonordinary custody, offline frontiers and real-tenant acceptance remain inactive or pending. SohImport independently reviewed source and cutoff -> outbound.goods_soh_views Start/Detail/Mutation -> goods_soh_reconciliation begin/submit/cancel/_decide -> SiteGuard SITE lock before RegisteredTill DOCUMENT lock -> snapshot_pause_evidence persisted TillPause, allocation/frontier/reservation/UUID reconciliation -> frozen canonical GoodsStocktake book -> independent versioned count.review -> zero-close or P13 reduction at original origin cost -> retained journal and goods stock readers; access revalidation before commit and DTO delivery. Fresh source inputs, stable identity/governance, working set, book/journal watermark, count reasons and approval versions are rechecked. Full offline till reconciliation and gains/encumbered/nonordinary differences remain unsupported/inactive.
records.acceptance_evidence: Reconcile before/after balances and preserve approval evidence. Later full SOH snapshots belong to C08/SO-08, using the retained goods count/correction journey; they must not replay opening balances or historical source movements. Pending dependencies: ptmapper.soh_services.requires_inventory_reconciliation and apply_batch initial-parent fence; outbound.goods_counts.start_count/current_declaration SiteGuard freeze and journal snapshot; C10/SO-09 registered-till pause, unresolved UUID outcomes and numbered-bill reconciliation; C06 retained stock journal/readers. Trading-store counts remain inactive until the separately approved R-INV-009/ST-INV-3/OQ-57 pause, source cutoff and independent delta review contracts have current evidence.
records.removal_condition: Retire duplicate count/correction writes when freeze, replay and authority tests pass.

Fresh source inputs, stable identity/governance, working set, book/journal watermark, count reasons and approval versions are rechecked. Full offline till reconciliation and gains/encumbered/nonordinary differences remain unsupported/inactive.

Trading-store counts remain inactive until the separately approved R-INV-009/ST-INV-3/OQ-57 pause, source cutoff and independent delta review contracts have current evidence.

records.migration_requirements: Map snapshots, blind passes, recounts, variances, reasons, approval bands and corrections to one journal. Later full SOH snapshots belong to C08/SO-08 retained correction/count, never another opening. The narrow sole-online-alpha trading snapshot adapter is implemented in outbound.goods_soh_reconciliation with exact persisted pause/frontier, SITE-before-DOCUMENT lock order and actual concurrency denial proof. Initial-parent repeat protection is implemented in ptmapper.soh_services. Generic non-trading counts retain their existing gate. Only zero/reduction closure is supported; gains, encumbrances, nonordinary custody, offline frontiers and real-tenant acceptance remain inactive or pending. SohImport independently reviewed source and cutoff -> outbound.goods_soh_views Start/Detail/Mutation -> goods_soh_reconciliation begin/submit/cancel/_decide -> SiteGuard SITE lock before RegisteredTill DOCUMENT lock -> snapshot_pause_evidence persisted TillPause, allocation/frontier/reservation/UUID reconciliation -> frozen canonical GoodsStocktake book -> independent versioned count.review -> zero-close or P13 reduction at original origin cost -> retained journal and goods stock readers; access revalidation before commit and DTO delivery. Fresh source inputs, stable identity/governance, working set, book/journal watermark, count reasons and approval versions are rechecked. Full offline till reconciliation and gains/encumbered/nonordinary differences remain unsupported/inactive.
records.acceptance_evidence: Reconcile before/after balances and preserve approval evidence. Later full SOH snapshots belong to C08/SO-08, using the retained goods count/correction journey; they must not replay opening balances or historical source movements. Pending dependencies: ptmapper.soh_services.requires_inventory_reconciliation and apply_batch initial-parent fence; outbound.goods_counts.start_count/current_declaration SiteGuard freeze and journal snapshot; C10/SO-09 registered-till pause, unresolved UUID outcomes and numbered-bill reconciliation; C06 retained stock journal/readers. Trading-store counts remain inactive until the separately approved R-INV-009/ST-INV-3/OQ-57 pause, source cutoff and independent delta review contracts have current evidence.
records.removal_condition: Retire duplicate count/correction writes when freeze, replay and authority tests pass.

records.migration_requirements: Map snapshots, blind passes, recounts, variances, reasons, approval bands and corrections to one journal. Later full SOH snapshots belong to C08/SO-08 retained correction/count, never another opening. The narrow sole-online-alpha trading snapshot adapter is implemented in outbound.goods_soh_reconciliation with exact persisted pause/frontier, SITE-before-DOCUMENT lock order and actual concurrency denial proof. Initial-parent repeat protection is implemented in ptmapper.soh_services. Generic non-trading counts retain their existing gate. Only zero/reduction closure is supported; gains, encumbrances, nonordinary custody, offline frontiers and real-tenant acceptance remain inactive or pending. SohImport independently reviewed source and cutoff -> outbound.goods_soh_views Start/Detail/Mutation -> goods_soh_reconciliation begin/submit/cancel/_decide -> SiteGuard SITE lock before RegisteredTill DOCUMENT lock -> snapshot_pause_evidence persisted TillPause, allocation/frontier/reservation/UUID reconciliation -> frozen canonical GoodsStocktake book -> independent versioned count.review -> zero-close or P13 reduction at original origin cost -> retained journal and goods stock readers; access revalidation before commit and DTO delivery. Fresh source inputs, stable identity/governance, working set, book/journal watermark, count reasons and approval versions are rechecked. Full offline till reconciliation and gains/encumbered/nonordinary differences remain unsupported/inactive.
records.acceptance_evidence: Reconcile before/after balances and preserve approval evidence. Later full SOH snapshots belong to C08/SO-08, using the retained goods count/correction journey; they must not replay opening balances or historical source movements. Pending dependencies: ptmapper.soh_services.requires_inventory_reconciliation and apply_batch initial-parent fence; outbound.goods_counts.start_count/current_declaration SiteGuard freeze and journal snapshot; C10/SO-09 registered-till pause, unresolved UUID outcomes and numbered-bill reconciliation; C06 retained stock journal/readers. Trading-store counts remain inactive until the separately approved R-INV-009/ST-INV-3/OQ-57 pause, source cutoff and independent delta review contracts have current evidence.
records.removal_condition: Retire duplicate count/correction writes when freeze, replay and authority tests pass.

records.replacement: `/goods/counts/*` is the count target; `/stock-count/*` schedule, adjustments and write-offs, `/stock/vflips/*` become one controlled correction/count journey
records.migration_requirements: Map snapshots, blind passes, recounts, variances, reasons, approval bands and corrections to one journal. Later full SOH snapshots belong to C08/SO-08 retained correction/count, never another opening. The narrow sole-online-alpha trading snapshot adapter is implemented in outbound.goods_soh_reconciliation with exact persisted pause/frontier, SITE-before-DOCUMENT lock order and actual concurrency denial proof. Initial-parent repeat protection is implemented in ptmapper.soh_services. Generic non-trading counts retain their existing gate. Only zero/reduction closure is supported; gains, encumbrances, nonordinary custody, offline frontiers and real-tenant acceptance remain inactive or pending. SohImport independently reviewed source and cutoff -> outbound.goods_soh_views Start/Detail/Mutation -> goods_soh_reconciliation begin/submit/cancel/_decide -> SiteGuard SITE lock before RegisteredTill DOCUMENT lock -> snapshot_pause_evidence persisted TillPause, allocation/frontier/reservation/UUID reconciliation -> frozen canonical GoodsStocktake book -> independent versioned count.review -> zero-close or P13 reduction at original origin cost -> retained journal and goods stock readers; access revalidation before commit and DTO delivery. Fresh source inputs, stable identity/governance, working set, book/journal watermark, count reasons and approval versions are rechecked. Full offline till reconciliation and gains/encumbered/nonordinary differences remain unsupported/inactive.
records.acceptance_evidence: Reconcile before/after balances and preserve approval evidence. Later full SOH snapshots belong to C08/SO-08, using the retained goods count/correction journey; they must not replay opening balances or historical source movements. Pending dependencies: ptmapper.soh_services.requires_inventory_reconciliation and apply_batch initial-parent fence; outbound.goods_counts.start_count/current_declaration SiteGuard freeze and journal snapshot; C10/SO-09 registered-till pause, unresolved UUID outcomes and numbered-bill reconciliation; C06 retained stock journal/readers. Trading-store counts remain inactive until the separately approved R-INV-009/ST-INV-3/OQ-57 pause, source cutoff and independent delta review contracts have current evidence.
records.removal_condition: Retire duplicate count/correction writes when freeze, replay and authority tests pass.

records.replacement: `/goods/counts/*` is the count target; `/stock-count/*` schedule, adjustments and write-offs, `/stock/vflips/*` become one controlled correction/count journey
records.migration_requirements: Map snapshots, blind passes, recounts, variances, reasons, approval bands and corrections to one journal. Later full SOH snapshots belong to C08/SO-08 retained correction/count, never another opening. The narrow sole-online-alpha trading snapshot adapter is implemented in outbound.goods_soh_reconciliation with exact persisted pause/frontier, SITE-before-DOCUMENT lock order and actual concurrency denial proof. Initial-parent repeat protection is implemented in ptmapper.soh_services. Generic non-trading counts retain their existing gate. Only zero/reduction closure is supported; gains, encumbrances, nonordinary custody, offline frontiers and real-tenant acceptance remain inactive or pending. SohImport independently reviewed source and cutoff -> outbound.goods_soh_views Start/Detail/Mutation -> goods_soh_reconciliation begin/submit/cancel/_decide -> SiteGuard SITE lock before RegisteredTill DOCUMENT lock -> snapshot_pause_evidence persisted TillPause, allocation/frontier/reservation/UUID reconciliation -> frozen canonical GoodsStocktake book -> independent versioned count.review -> zero-close or P13 reduction at original origin cost -> retained journal and goods stock readers; access revalidation before commit and DTO delivery. Fresh source inputs, stable identity/governance, working set, book/journal watermark, count reasons and approval versions are rechecked. Full offline till reconciliation and gains/encumbered/nonordinary differences remain unsupported/inactive.
records.acceptance_evidence: Reconcile before/after balances and preserve approval evidence. Later full SOH snapshots belong to C08/SO-08, using the retained goods count/correction journey; they must not replay opening balances or historical source movements. Pending dependencies: ptmapper.soh_services.requires_inventory_reconciliation and apply_batch initial-parent fence; outbound.goods_counts.start_count/current_declaration SiteGuard freeze and journal snapshot; C10/SO-09 registered-till pause, unresolved UUID outcomes and numbered-bill reconciliation; C06 retained stock journal/readers. Trading-store counts remain inactive until the separately approved R-INV-009/ST-INV-3/OQ-57 pause, source cutoff and independent delta review contracts have current evidence.
records.removal_condition: Retire duplicate count/correction writes when freeze, replay and authority tests pass.

Later full SOH snapshots belong to C08/SO-08 retained correction/count, never another opening. The narrow sole-online-alpha trading snapshot adapter is implemented in outbound.goods_soh_reconciliation with exact persisted pause/frontier, SITE-before-DOCUMENT lock order and actual concurrency denial proof. Initial-parent repeat protection is implemented in ptmapper.soh_services. Generic non-trading counts retain their existing gate. Only zero/reduction closure is supported; gains, encumbrances, nonordinary custody, offline frontiers and real-tenant acceptance remain inactive or pending. SohImport independently reviewed source and cutoff -> outbound.goods_soh_views Start/Detail/Mutation -> goods_soh_reconciliation begin/submit/cancel/_decide -> SiteGuard SITE lock before RegisteredTill DOCUMENT lock -> snapshot_pause_evidence persisted TillPause, allocation/frontier/reservation/UUID reconciliation -> frozen canonical GoodsStocktake book -> independent versioned count.review -> zero-close or P13 reduction at original origin cost -> retained journal and goods stock readers; access revalidation before commit and DTO delivery. Fresh source inputs, stable identity/governance, working set, book/journal watermark, count reasons and approval versions are rechecked. Full offline till reconciliation and gains/encumbered/nonordinary differences remain unsupported/inactive.
records.acceptance_evidence: Reconcile before/after balances and preserve approval evidence. Later full SOH snapshots belong to C08/SO-08, using the retained goods count/correction journey; they must not replay opening balances or historical source movements. Pending dependencies: ptmapper.soh_services.requires_inventory_reconciliation and apply_batch initial-parent fence; outbound.goods_counts.start_count/current_declaration SiteGuard freeze and journal snapshot; C10/SO-09 registered-till pause, unresolved UUID outcomes and numbered-bill reconciliation; C06 retained stock journal/readers. Trading-store counts remain inactive until the separately approved R-INV-009/ST-INV-3/OQ-57 pause, source cutoff and independent delta review contracts have current evidence.

records.migration_requirements: Map snapshots, blind passes, recounts, variances, reasons, approval bands and corrections to one journal. Later full SOH snapshots belong to C08/SO-08 retained correction/count, never another opening. The narrow sole-online-alpha trading snapshot adapter is implemented in outbound.goods_soh_reconciliation with exact persisted pause/frontier, SITE-before-DOCUMENT lock order and actual concurrency denial proof. Initial-parent repeat protection is implemented in ptmapper.soh_services. Generic non-trading counts retain their existing gate. Only zero/reduction closure is supported; gains, encumbrances, nonordinary custody, offline frontiers and real-tenant acceptance remain inactive or pending. SohImport independently reviewed source and cutoff -> outbound.goods_soh_views Start/Detail/Mutation -> goods_soh_reconciliation begin/submit/cancel/_decide -> SiteGuard SITE lock before RegisteredTill DOCUMENT lock -> snapshot_pause_evidence persisted TillPause, allocation/frontier/reservation/UUID reconciliation -> frozen canonical GoodsStocktake book -> independent versioned count.review -> zero-close or P13 reduction at original origin cost -> retained journal and goods stock readers; access revalidation before commit and DTO delivery. Fresh source inputs, stable identity/governance, working set, book/journal watermark, count reasons and approval versions are rechecked. Full offline till reconciliation and gains/encumbered/nonordinary differences remain unsupported/inactive.
records.acceptance_evidence: Reconcile before/after balances and preserve approval evidence. Later full SOH snapshots belong to C08/SO-08, using the retained goods count/correction journey; they must not replay opening balances or historical source movements. Pending dependencies: ptmapper.soh_services.requires_inventory_reconciliation and apply_batch initial-parent fence; outbound.goods_counts.start_count/current_declaration SiteGuard freeze and journal snapshot; C10/SO-09 registered-till pause, unresolved UUID outcomes and numbered-bill reconciliation; C06 retained stock journal/readers. Trading-store counts remain inactive until the separately approved R-INV-009/ST-INV-3/OQ-57 pause, source cutoff and independent delta review contracts have current evidence.
records.removal_condition: Retire duplicate count/correction writes when freeze, replay and authority tests pass.

records.migration_requirements: Map snapshots, blind passes, recounts, variances, reasons, approval bands and corrections to one journal. Later full SOH snapshots belong to C08/SO-08 retained correction/count, never another opening. The narrow sole-online-alpha trading snapshot adapter is implemented in outbound.goods_soh_reconciliation with exact persisted pause/frontier, SITE-before-DOCUMENT lock order and actual concurrency denial proof. Initial-parent repeat protection is implemented in ptmapper.soh_services. Generic non-trading counts retain their existing gate. Only zero/reduction closure is supported; gains, encumbrances, nonordinary custody, offline frontiers and real-tenant acceptance remain inactive or pending. SohImport independently reviewed source and cutoff -> outbound.goods_soh_views Start/Detail/Mutation -> goods_soh_reconciliation begin/submit/cancel/_decide -> SiteGuard SITE lock before RegisteredTill DOCUMENT lock -> snapshot_pause_evidence persisted TillPause, allocation/frontier/reservation/UUID reconciliation -> frozen canonical GoodsStocktake book -> independent versioned count.review -> zero-close or P13 reduction at original origin cost -> retained journal and goods stock readers; access revalidation before commit and DTO delivery. Fresh source inputs, stable identity/governance, working set, book/journal watermark, count reasons and approval versions are rechecked. Full offline till reconciliation and gains/encumbered/nonordinary differences remain unsupported/inactive.
records.acceptance_evidence: Reconcile before/after balances and preserve approval evidence. Later full SOH snapshots belong to C08/SO-08, using the retained goods count/correction journey; they must not replay opening balances or historical source movements. Pending dependencies: ptmapper.soh_services.requires_inventory_reconciliation and apply_batch initial-parent fence; outbound.goods_counts.start_count/current_declaration SiteGuard freeze and journal snapshot; C10/SO-09 registered-till pause, unresolved UUID outcomes and numbered-bill reconciliation; C06 retained stock journal/readers. Trading-store counts remain inactive until the separately approved R-INV-009/ST-INV-3/OQ-57 pause, source cutoff and independent delta review contracts have current evidence.
records.removal_condition: Retire duplicate count/correction writes when freeze, replay and authority tests pass.

records.migration_requirements: Map snapshots, blind passes, recounts, variances, reasons, approval bands and corrections to one journal. Later full SOH snapshots belong to C08/SO-08 retained correction/count, never another opening. The narrow sole-online-alpha trading snapshot adapter is implemented in outbound.goods_soh_reconciliation with exact persisted pause/frontier, SITE-before-DOCUMENT lock order and actual concurrency denial proof. Initial-parent repeat protection is implemented in ptmapper.soh_services. Generic non-trading counts retain their existing gate. Only zero/reduction closure is supported; gains, encumbrances, nonordinary custody, offline frontiers and real-tenant acceptance remain inactive or pending. SohImport independently reviewed source and cutoff -> outbound.goods_soh_views Start/Detail/Mutation -> goods_soh_reconciliation begin/submit/cancel/_decide -> SiteGuard SITE lock before RegisteredTill DOCUMENT lock -> snapshot_pause_evidence persisted TillPause, allocation/frontier/reservation/UUID reconciliation -> frozen canonical GoodsStocktake book -> independent versioned count.review -> zero-close or P13 reduction at original origin cost -> retained journal and goods stock readers; access revalidation before commit and DTO delivery. Fresh source inputs, stable identity/governance, working set, book/journal watermark, count reasons and approval versions are rechecked. Full offline till reconciliation and gains/encumbered/nonordinary differences remain unsupported/inactive.
records.acceptance_evidence: Reconcile before/after balances and preserve approval evidence. Later full SOH snapshots belong to C08/SO-08, using the retained goods count/correction journey; they must not replay opening balances or historical source movements. Pending dependencies: ptmapper.soh_services.requires_inventory_reconciliation and apply_batch initial-parent fence; outbound.goods_counts.start_count/current_declaration SiteGuard freeze and journal snapshot; C10/SO-09 registered-till pause, unresolved UUID outcomes and numbered-bill reconciliation; C06 retained stock journal/readers. Trading-store counts remain inactive until the separately approved R-INV-009/ST-INV-3/OQ-57 pause, source cutoff and independent delta review contracts have current evidence.
records.removal_condition: Retire duplicate count/correction writes when freeze, replay and authority tests pass.

Full offline till reconciliation and gains/encumbered/nonordinary differences remain unsupported/inactive.
